summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a sibling file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line Bun-targeted bundle using string-array rotation, hex-encoded literals, and opaque `_0x...` identifier names; its content is unrelated to the package's advertised verdaccio local-storage plugin purpose. The obfuscated bundle is not declared in `package.json`'s `"files": ["dist", "src"]` manifest, indicating it is smuggled into the published tarball outside the normal shipping surface. The package name and description (`Cropped and fixed version of the @verdaccio/local-storage plugin`) impersonate the legitimate `@verdaccio/local-storage` plugin. On `npm install`, arbitrary attacker-controlled code executes on the installer's machine under an alien runtime not required by the declared functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
